verdicts.title: Synthesis and Optimization of Reversible Circuits for Homogeneous Boolean Functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Homogenous Boolean function is an essential part of any cryptographic system. The ability to construct an optimized reversible circuits for homogeneous Boolean functions might arise the possibility of building cryptographic system on novel computing paradigms such as quantum computers. This paper shows a factorization algorithm to synthesize such circuits.
